name: zclass_window_close_clear_polygon
description: zClass_Window::gwWindowCloseClearPolygon validates the window node, submits the active clear polygon to span occlusion, advances the clear-polygon index with the high-bit flag set, and returns the closed polygon index.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass window/source-cluster pass because the clear-polygon helpers and shared validation path should be byte-reviewed together.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x44fcf0 validates the null node, null data, wrong-class, and full clear-polygon buffer error paths; passes the selected clearPolys[result] vertex array and masked vertCount to zRndr::SpanOcclusionAddPolygon; advances clearPolyIndexFlags with the high bit set; and returns the closed polygon index.

The native smoke verifies successful close of a polygon added through gwWindowAddClearPolygonVertex, span-occluder handoff, advanced high-bit clear-polygon index, full-buffer error return, and null node, null data, and wrong-class return codes.
